C-widgets.hook: Too many apps to run your day?
C-widgets.i1: One. Food. Calories and macros, on my Home Screen and my Lock Screen.
C-widgets.i2: Two. Training. My next set, my streak, and a live rest timer.
C-widgets.i3: Three. Money and my day. Budget, habits, and my top three.
C-widgets.styles: Then customize it all. Mix the shapes, pick a style, and match your wallpaper.
C-widgets.end: Ardane. Your whole life. One place.

J1-journey-full.hook: My Home Screen knows what I just ate.

J1-journey-full.custom: Then I make the widget mine. New style, new colors.
J1-journey-full.place: And it goes on my Home Screen, right next to my workout.

J2-journey-phone.place: Drop it on your Home Screen. Every meal, at a glance.

W1-workout-phone.hook: Want to level up your workouts?

W1-workout-phone.widget: Then in Create, pick the widget that follows your exercise, and make it your style.

S1-student-notebook.week: Every class, every room, in my week.
